market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month settled ~$99.93 on Apr 28, 2026 amid US-Iran standoff and seven straight up sessions; Brent already at ~$111. World Bank cites disruption risk. To hit $115 settle by end of June requires a 15% rally, which is plausible if escalation continues or any Hormuz/Gulf disruption hits. Mild discount vs market's 0.60.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran negotiations succeed quickly or escalate into actual disruption
